trigger.Name: PlayerVehAndRandom
trigger.script:
GetPlayerVehicle():SetNameFromScript("PlayerOwnCar") GetPlayerVehicle():SetGamePositionOnGround( CVector(1831.811, 375.276, 1834.494)) CapturePlayerVehicle() AddPlayerVehicle("ArcadeScout02") GetPlayerVehicle():SetPosition( CVector(2603.933, 322.643, 1698.991)) GetPlayerVehicle():SetRotation(Quaternion(0.003, -1.000, -0.003, 0.024)) GetPlayerVehicle():setImmortalMode(1) GetPlayerVehicle():SetSkin(random(0,2))
TeamCreate("Enemy1",1101,CVector(2570.735, 322.577, 1690.726),{"ArcadeScout02"}) TeamCreate("Enemy2",1102,CVector(2657.204, 322.829, 1683.914),{"ArcadeScout02"}) TeamCreate("Enemy3",1103,CVector(2694.642, 322.684, 1690.257),{"ArcadeScout02"}) TeamCreate("Enemy4",1104,CVector(2706.522, 322.697, 1664.335),{"ArcadeScout02"}) TeamCreate("Enemy5",1105,CVector(2687.767, 322.676, 1594.142),{"ArcadeScout02"}) TeamCreate("Enemy6",1106,CVector(2614.555, 322.678, 1601.007),{"ArcadeScout02"}) TeamCreate("Enemy7",1107,CVector(2564.547, 323.481, 1612.778),{"ArcadeScout02"}) g_Console:InputLine '/ai_clash_coeff 0' TActivate("KillCounterTeam1Ally") TActivate("PlayerDie") TActivate("LocLeavePl") TActivate("LocLeaveBot1") TActivate("LocLeaveBot2") TActivate("LocLeaveBot3") TActivate("LocLeaveBot4") TActivate("LocLeaveBot5") TActivate("LocLeaveBot6") TActivate("LocLeaveBot7") AllowSave(0) trigger:Deactivate()

trigger.Name: KillCounterTeam1Ally
trigger.script: trigger:IncCount() local count = trigger:GetCount() if 7>count then return end SpawnMessageBox("2") AddPlayerMoney(5000) CapturePlayerVehicle() local ownplvh = getObj("PlayerOwnCar") g_Player:AddChild(ownplvh) PassToMap("r1m3", "Minin_enter") StopPlayingCustomMusic() local diff = GetDifficultyLevel() if diff == 0 then RuleConsole("/ai_clash_coeff 0.000015") RuleConsole("/ai_player_weapons_damage_coeff 1.5") RuleConsole("/ai_enemies_ramming_damage_coeff 2") RuleConsole("/ai_min_hit_velocity 30") elseif diff == 1 then RuleConsole("/ai_clash_coeff 0.000015") RuleConsole("/ai_player_weapons_damage_coeff 1") RuleConsole("/ai_enemies_ramming_damage_coeff 1") RuleConsole("/ai_min_hit_velocity 30") elseif diff == 2 then RuleConsole("/ai_clash_coeff 0.003") RuleConsole("/ai_player_weapons_damage_coeff 0.75") RuleConsole("/ai_enemies_ramming_damage_coeff 1") RuleConsole("/ai_min_hit_velocity 30") end AllowSave(1) GetPlayerVehicle():SetCustomControlEnabled(0) trigger:Deactivate()

trigger.Name: PlayerDie
trigger.script: if 2 > GetPlayerVehicle():GetHealth() then SpawnMessageBox("3") AddPlayerMoney(5000) CapturePlayerVehicle() local ownplvh = getObj("PlayerOwnCar") g_Player:AddChild(ownplvh) PassToMap("r1m3", "Minin_enter") local diff = GetDifficultyLevel() if diff == 0 then RuleConsole("/ai_clash_coeff 0.000015") RuleConsole("/ai_player_weapons_damage_coeff 1.5") RuleConsole("/ai_enemies_ramming_damage_coeff 2") RuleConsole("/ai_min_hit_velocity 30") elseif diff == 1 then RuleConsole("/ai_clash_coeff 0.000015") RuleConsole("/ai_player_weapons_damage_coeff 1") RuleConsole("/ai_enemies_ramming_damage_coeff 1") RuleConsole("/ai_min_hit_velocity 30") elseif diff == 2 then RuleConsole("/ai_clash_coeff 0.003") RuleConsole("/ai_player_weapons_damage_coeff 0.75") RuleConsole("/ai_enemies_ramming_damage_coeff 1") RuleConsole("/ai_min_hit_velocity 30") end StopPlayingCustomMusic() AllowSave(1) GetPlayerVehicle():SetCustomControlEnabled(0) trigger:Deactivate() end
